admitted.quote: Vee's my dear friend

admitted.quote: Love you, girl," Randi said

admitted.quote: How much did he give you to drink?

admitted.quote: We had tea, Cassie

admitted.quote: I did it because I wanted to and I did it on purpose.

admitted.text: Vee spins in celebration.
admitted.quote: she spun, once, quick, arms going up

admitted.text: Cassie asks whether Pace is rich.
admitted.quote: Rich people hike. Poor people walk.

admitted.text: Vee has not seen Pace's house.
admitted.quote: I haven't been out there yet. To the house.

admitted.quote: Six days later, the professor took them up to the edge

admitted.text: Cassie leaves alone.
admitted.quote: I'll see you at the dorm

admitted.text: Vee says the smoothie place is not Cassie's kind of place.
admitted.quote: And it isn't really her place, the smoothie one.

admitted.quote: The Smoothie Bird sat on its corner with the windows full of orange.

admitted.text: Randi orders a beet and wheatgrass smoothie.
admitted.quote: beet and wheatgrass and egg white and oat milk

admitted.text: Vee orders strawberry banana.
admitted.quote: Vee got the strawberry banana.

admitted.text: Randi tells Vee about a bad date.
admitted.quote: My love life is a disaster.

admitted.quote: and then he said, 'May I choose?'

admitted.text: Randi says Vee kissed Pace because of him.
admitted.quote: Because you couldn't not. Because of him.

admitted.text: Vee says the hike is Sunday.
admitted.quote: Sunday. There's a trail he goes to.

admitted.text: Randi teases Vee about being ravished.
admitted.quote: Hair down, no bra, let your mountain man ravish you against a tree.

admitted.text: Randi says "ask and then ravish."
admitted.quote: Ask and then ravish

admitted.quote: He'd ask, though

admitted.quote: We missed you Thursday

admitted.text: Vee says they have stats together.
admitted.quote: We have stats together.

admitted.quote: We should all get dinner sometime

admitted.text: Vee feels picked.
admitted.quote: She felt picked. She carried it the whole way home.

admitted.text: Randi reassures Vee that she behaved perfectly.
admitted.quote: You were perfect. Annoyingly perfect.

admitted.text: Vee tells Randi she kissed Pace after two days.
admitted.quote: Two days I'd known him.

admitted.text: Vee tells Randi about her dinner with Pace.
admitted.quote: Mine wasn't glamorous like yours.

admitted.text: Brooke approaches Randi and Vee in the smoothie shop.
admitted.quote: Brooke," Randi said to the smile

admitted.quote: The shirt came open the whole way

admitted.text: Vee keeps Pace's flannel.
admitted.quote: I kept the shirt. I didn't ask.

admitted.text: Vee exits before finishing what she wanted to say.
admitted.quote: Her body had already heard the siren and gone.

admitted.text: Pace's white pickup.
admitted.quote: the old white pickup, the white gone dull in the wet

admitted.text: The trail climbs from a gravel lot.
admitted.quote: The trail came out of the gravel lot and went straight up into the trees

admitted.text: Vee wears Meg's boots, which are too big.
admitted.quote: Meg's boots, a half-size big, stiff at the ankle

admitted.text: Pace wears a bright blue shirt.
admitted.quote: His shirt was bright blue.

admitted.text: Vee's right boot rubs her heel.
admitted.quote: The right one. It's rubbing.

admitted.text: Pace puts moleskin on Vee's heel.
admitted.quote: cut a square of moleskin, pressed it to her heel with his thumb

admitted.text: The summit looks over a lake.
admitted.quote: in the valley lay a lake holding the silver sky in it

admitted.text: Pace watches Vee's face instead of the view.
admitted.quote: he was already looking at her — not at the valley, at her face in front of the valley

admitted.text: Pace made sandwiches with horseradish.
admitted.quote: It's the horseradish. It does that.

admitted.quote: he drank from it where her mouth had been

admitted.quote: We take nothing and leave nothing

admitted.quote: It was silk. Russet

admitted.text: Pace says the dress sounds beautiful.
admitted.quote: That sounds like a beautiful dress.

admitted.text: Rain catches them on the way down.
admitted.quote: It came down hard.

admitted.text: Pace gives Vee his only dry shirt.
admitted.quote: His only dry shirt.

admitted.quote: he walked a few steps off and stood with his back to the truck

admitted.quote: She rapped on the driver's window with her knuckles, three quick

admitted.quote: She lifted a hand off the bench and crooked a finger at him.

admitted.text: Pace watches without touching Vee.
admitted.quote: He didn't lean in. He didn't lift a hand.

admitted.text: Vee finds that Pace is shivering.
admitted.quote: He was shivering. He'd been shivering.

admitted.quote: the fire lane, the red-painted curb

admitted.text: A campus police car pulls up behind them.
admitted.quote: The campus cop, pulled up behind, lights going.

admitted.text: The siren sends Vee out of the truck.
admitted.quote: She pushed the door open and she went, the three steps to the doors.

admitted.text: Vee says she is keeping the shirt.
admitted.quote: I'm keeping the shirt.

admitted.quote: She had said yes to this walking back from the dinner

admitted.quote: cut a square of moleskin, pressed it to her heel

admitted.text: Vee removes her wet shirt while Pace watches.
admitted.quote: And I took my wet shirt off in front of him.

admitted.text: Pace knows Vee's borrowed boots do not fit after she reports rubbing.
admitted.quote: The right one. It's rubbing.

admitted.text: Vee learns the leave-no-trace rule from Pace.
admitted.quote: We take nothing and leave nothing

admitted.text: Pace learns that Vee wants a russet silk dress.
admitted.quote: It was silk. Russet

admitted.text: Pace teaches Vee to carry out the cherry pits.
admitted.quote: We take nothing and leave nothing

admitted.text: Pace sets a slow pace for Vee.
admitted.quote: He walked at the speed of her not knowing how.

admitted.text: Pace removes Vee's boot and sock.
admitted.quote: her bare foot was in his hand

admitted.text: Vee reaches the summit.
admitted.quote: The trees ended all at once and the world fell open

admitted.text: Pace watches Vee see the valley.
admitted.quote: he was already looking at her

admitted.quote: Made them this morning

admitted.text: Vee spits a cherry pit onto the rock.
admitted.quote: She spit the pit.

admitted.text: Pace tells Vee to leave nothing behind.
admitted.quote: We take nothing and leave nothing

admitted.quote: put it with the others on the wax paper

admitted.quote: She told him about the induction.

admitted.quote: He drew it out from under the rest and held it out to her

admitted.quote: He opened his door and got out.

admitted.text: Vee summons Pace back into the truck.
admitted.quote: She rapped on the driver's window

admitted.quote: Then her hands went to the top button of her shirt.

admitted.quote: She picked up the flannel. She pulled it on

admitted.quote: She brought his hand in against her belly

admitted.quote: pulled the truck up the drive to the entrance

admitted.quote: The siren squawked — one short electronic bark

admitted.quote: So Vee told her
